title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Design na Lemon

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Já viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. We’re looking for a UX Designer excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you’ll own initiatives across the entire player journey—from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure visual and technical execution supports usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes that build confidence in our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: designing with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

Send your e‑mail to ****** with a subject like “UX Designer‑ Your Name” and include your resume and portfolio. Feel free to add any details about yourself that you’d like to share.

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio dedicated to creating player‑first video games with compelling stories and lasting experiences.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

Other

  • Salary and career information are not provided in this posting.

Overview

Como Administrador(a) de Banco de Dados Sênior (DBA), com especialidade em SQL Server, você gerenciará e manterá o sistema de banco de dados SQL Server, garantindo a integridade dos dados, performance e segurança. Lidera iniciativas complexas, orienta DBAs mais juniores e atua como referência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar e manter instâncias e bancos de dados SQL Server (versões 2012 a 2022).
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Recovery (Full, Differential, Transaction log, Point-in-time recovery).
  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.
  • Configurar e gerenciar a Auditoria do SQL Server para fins de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de performance de queries complexas, analisando planos de execução, utilizando Query Store e definindo estratégias de indexação.
  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.
  • Realizar tuning de I/O, CPU e Memória para otimizar a performance do SQL Server.
  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.
  • Desenvolver scripts em PowerShell para automação de tarefas administrativas e de manutenção.
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. $78,926.75 — $132,650 USD

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Benefits

Full time employees receive a competitive total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in Samsara domain. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Overview

Ux Designer role at Memory Ware. Memory Ware is a fully remote studio focused on player-first experiences in games, with a JRPG-inspired design ethos.

We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative. You’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration. You should be able to envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You will collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

Responsibilities

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) are intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the gameplay loop and propose smart, game-genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure visual and technical execution supports usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low-fidelity prototypes.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy and ability to engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Email your resume and portfolio; include any details about yourself you’d like to share. Send your email to the address provided with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name".

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, focused on sustainably creating video games with a player-first philosophy, crafting stories and experiences that create lasting memories for players. We are a self-funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you’re eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

Location & Type

Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil — Full-time, Remote-friendly role. Seniority: Mid-Senior level.

THE EXPERIENCE YOU WILL BRING

Proven industry experience in Application support and capable of owning the team responsibility, with at least 7-14 years of experience in supporting capital markets solutions that process financial instruments.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Previous experience in Incident management / escalation process / change management process.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical persons with proven experience of working with business stakeholders and external clients.

Willingness to take ownership for problem resolution and additional responsibilities where applicable.

Strong scripting and programming skills.

High proficiency with Linux environments (Amazon Linux 2023, Redhat and CentOS).

Good understanding of networking and client/server technology ( websockets and ports), FIX connectivity is also a bonus.

Worked with and have an understanding of cloud computing and environments, ideally AWS hosting.

Proven industry experience following Agile Software Development practices.

Knowledge of the typical flows and functionality associated with handing business flows in one or more asset types; equities, fixed income, FX, listed future and option, OTC derivatives.

The ability to constructively participate and critique in technical and functional discussions with talented technical architects and lead developers.

Process excellence – a passion to achieve results though effective organization and process disciplines.

Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Ability to maintain confidence and composure in all situations.

Self-starter with strong sense of ownership.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos. Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito. Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália. No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte. Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Descrição da vaga

Como Mecânica Industrial I você será responsável por executar as atividades de manutenção mecânica preventiva e corretiva em máquinas e equipamentos de Usina, atendendo a programações e solicitações de manutenção.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso profissionalizante em mecânica
  • Desejável CNH - categoria B.
  • Residência em Conceição do Mato Dentro/MG, Serro/MG, Congonhas do Norte/MG, Dom Joaquim/MG ou Alvorada de Minas/MG.

Informações adicionais

Por que fazer parte do nosso time? Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

  • Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional
  • Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!
  • Espaço para ser você mesmo: Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!
  • Para seu futuro: Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado
  • E ainda: Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Compromisso com segurança e diversidade

Nada é mais importante do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Temos padrões de segurança rigorosos e investimos em tecnologias para tornar a mineração mais segura. Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, onde valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega. Acolhemos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. Criamos Grupos de Afinidades para discutir, refletir e agir sobre inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho. Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

Processo seletivo

Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição. Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído pelas seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento às comunicações (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas. Venha com a gente construir o futuro da mineração!

  • Months 3–12: broaden scope, own problems.

  • Comfortable context switching and working cross‑functionally in a remote environment.

Nice‑to‑haves

  • SQL comfort (reading/editing simple SELECT/JOIN/WHERE) and curiosity to learn more; exposure to Databricks/Looker helpful.

O Product Owner é responsável por maximizar o valor do produto resultante do trabalho da equipe de desenvolvimento.
